scope: Scientific completeness, editorial coherence, artifact provenance, and final delivery boundaries

display_verification.figure_visual_review: Recorded per figure in method_figure_review.json and physical_figure_review.json; root also viewed the two listed core plots at full size.
display_verification.html_formulas_and_links: Build-time KaTeX strict parsing and static HTML/resource audit.
display_verification.browser_desktop_mobile_print: NOT performed. The available browser rejected local file protocol. No alternate browser or indirect route was used to circumvent that rejection.
display_verification.remaining_limit: Responsive and print CSS is statically reviewed; live browser layout and print pagination are not certified.

scientific_limits: Only two Fresh development training seeds and 32 generated fields per arm/sampling setting.
Finite MC reference and fixed gradient probe.
No D1, auxiliary-ratio ablation, Fresh direct-coarse generation, or Fresh exact joint diagnostic.
No independent confirmatory phase C; physical non-inferiority tolerances are not frozen.

delivery.workspace_policy: Only the isolated publication checkout is edited or staged; the user's original workspace is untouched.
